name: Prayer Sole — Compound Fastened (v3.9.1)
description: A three-piece Prayer Sole: rigid PLA collar, soft TPU tread, and a cap secured with M3×20 socket-head cap screws to the kneeler leg — no glue required. Optional PETG bolt retainers clip onto the cap screws to prevent loss during assembly.

printSettings.cap: Polymaker PLA Pro (Burgundy) | 4 Wall Loops | 35% Gyroid Infill
printSettings.collar: Polymaker PLA Pro (Burgundy) | 4 Wall Loops | 35% Gyroid Infill
printSettings.tread: TPU 90A (Black) | 4 Wall Loops | 35% Gyroid Infill | Print Speed < 40mm/s
printSettings.boltRetainer: PETG or Nylon | 4 Wall Loops | Print Qty: 2

assemblyGuide: Clean surfaces: remove any stringing from the internal wedge cavity.
Press-fit: press the TPU tread into the PLA cavity until flush.
Slide the assembly onto the kneeler leg.
Install two M3×20 socket-head cap screws through the cap bosses into the collar nut pockets.
Optional: push a bolt retainer onto each screw shank at the cap split face.
